line_items.reasoning: Q1 total revenue came in at ~$5.47B (Data Center $2.3B + Client $1.4B + Gaming $922M + Embedded $846M), landing at the high end of and slightly above the guided ~$5.4B +/- $300M range, while Data Center GPU momentum prompted a raise of the full-year GPU outlook from $3.5B to $4B+.
Non-GAAP gross margin came in at exactly 52%, matching the guided ~52% target, though MI300 GPU margins remain a drag below corporate average, keeping the result squarely in line rather than a beat.
Gaming declined 33% sequentially, which is right at the guided 'exceed 30%' threshold — essentially matching the low end of what was telegraphed, with no meaningful upside surprise.

Embedded fell 20% sequentially, worse than the guided low double-digit percentage decline (~10–12%), and the recovery outlook was pushed out with H2 now expected to be only gradual rather than a clear rebound.

Data Center operating income surged 266% YoY and Client swung to profitability, demonstrating strong operating leverage well ahead of top-line revenue growth, consistent with management's commitment to faster EPS growth than revenue.
Non-GAAP operating expenses came in at ~$1.7B, slightly below the guided ~$1.73B, indicating modest favorability on the cost line despite aggressive AI R&D investment.
